fixes.pipeline: keep numeric stem suffix tokens (e.g. '6.1' -> '.1') as a path:name column so overrides can separate N.0 (transmitted light -> light microscopy / brightfield, no stain) from N.1 (fluorescence); the exclude_paths above is the cheap alternative that drops half the images
